VERDICT: FAIL

The self-report is the only evidence—no CI log, diff, or independent artifact verifies the fix or the passing tests. Additionally, the described change (moving cursor advance after ack to fix a retry-loss bug) doesn't clearly match the stated task (an off-by-one boundary skipping the last record), raising doubt that the actual acceptance criterion was met. Unverifiable claims cannot be accepted as satisfying the criteria.
